title: NATO holds emergency meeting after Russian missiles land in Poland
caption:
NATO allies are meeting in Brussels after Russian missiles came down in southeastern Poland on Friday, during a large Russian attack on Ukraine. Nobody was hurt. Prime Minister Donald Tusk called it an intentional provocation, and NATO chief Mark Rutte said the alliance will defend every inch of Polish territory. Poland is asking allies for stronger protection of its eastern border.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
